requirements.title: Comprehensive ATM Access
requirements.description: Fee-free ATM transactions at over 55,000 locations through the Allpoint network, with an ATM locator and map interface for convenience.
requirements.user_story: As a cardholder, I want to have convenient and fee-free access to my money through a wide network of ATMs.
acceptance_criteria: Fee-free ATM access is available at Allpoint network locations
No fees are charged for ATM withdrawals
ATM locator and map interface are available

test_steps.action: Find an Allpoint network ATM location
test_steps.expected_result: ATM location is found and fee-free

test_steps.action: Withdraw cash from the ATM and verify no fees are charged
test_steps.expected_result: Cash is withdrawn and no fees are charged

test_scenarios: Withdrawing cash from multiple Allpoint network ATMs
assumptions: The ATM is part of the Allpoint network
ambiguities: What happens if the ATM is not part of the Allpoint network?

requirements.title: Secure Card Management
requirements.description: Ability to freeze/unfreeze cards instantly through a mobile app interface, with security measures to ensure only authorized users can perform these actions.
requirements.user_story: As a cardholder, I want to be able to control my card’s status for security purposes.
acceptance_criteria: Card can be frozen/unfrozen from the app
Card status is updated in real-time
Security measures are in place to prevent unauthorized actions

test_steps.action: Open the app and navigate to card settings
Freeze the card and verify the status
test_steps.expected_result: Card is frozen and status is updated

test_scenarios: Freezing and unfreezing the card multiple times
assumptions: The app has the necessary permissions to freeze/unfreeze the card
ambiguities: What happens if the card is frozen/unfrozen multiple times in a row?

requirements.title: Cashback Rewards
requirements.description: Earn 1% cashback on all purchases, with the ability to track expenditures and earn bonus cashback on specific categories.
requirements.user_story: As a cardholder, I want to earn cashback rewards on my purchases to get more value from my debit card.
acceptance_criteria: 1% cashback is earned on all debit card purchases
Bonus cashback categories are available and rotate monthly

test_steps.action: Make a purchase using the debit card
test_steps.expected_result: 1% cashback is earned on the purchase

test_steps.action: Verify that the cashback is deposited to the savings account weekly
test_steps.expected_result: Cashback is deposited to the savings account weekly

assumptions: The purchase is eligible for cashback rewards
ambiguities: What happens if the purchase is not eligible for cashback rewards?

requirements.title: Real-Time Market Data
requirements.description: Continuous stream of current market data for informed trading decisions, achieved through integration with Alpaca Markets API.
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to view real-time market data, so that I can make informed trading decisions.
assumptions: Alpaca Markets API integration is enabled

requirements.title: Instant P2P Transfers
requirements.description: Initiate peer-to-peer instant transfers securely through biometric verification and FedNow integration.
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to initiate a P2P instant transfer, so that I can send money quickly.

requirements.title: Secure Transaction Processing
requirements.description: Ensure all transactions are secure, including encryption of sensitive data and compliance with regulatory requirements.
requirements.user_story: As a system administrator, I want to ensure that all transactions are secure and compliant with regulations.
acceptance_criteria: Compliance with regulatory requirements is maintained
ambiguities: What is the format of the encrypted transactions?

requirements.title: Account Verification
requirements.description: System initiates micro-deposits to verify account ownership
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to verify my account, so that I can ensure secure transactions

requirements.title: Debit Card Transaction Authorization
requirements.description: System authorizes debit card transactions
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to authorize debit card transactions, so that I can securely make purchases

requirements.title: Order Routing
requirements.description: System directs orders to appropriate destinations for execution
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to route orders, so that I can trade securities

requirements.title: App Performance
requirements.description: App launches quickly and provides a smooth user experience
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want the app to launch quickly, so that I can start using it immediately
acceptance_criteria: App launches to home screen in under 3 seconds

requirements.title: Security and Compliance
requirements.description: App handles card data securely and complies with PCI DSS Level 1 requirements
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want my card data to be handled securely, so that I can trust the app with my financial information
acceptance_criteria: App handles card data in compliance with PCI DSS Level 1 certification requirements

requirements.title: Uptime and Availability
requirements.description: System maintains an uptime of 99.99% on a monthly basis
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to access my banking services at any time, so that I can manage my finances as needed
acceptance_criteria: Core banking services have an uptime SLA of 99.99%

requirements.title: Savings Goal Setting
requirements.description: User interface to input target amount and target date for savings goals
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to create savings goals, so that I can track my progress

requirements.title: Automated Savings
requirements.description: Rounded-up amount is deposited into a savings account
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want my purchases to be rounded up, so that I can save more
acceptance_criteria: Purchases are rounded up to nearest dollar
Rounded-up amount is deposited into savings

requirements.title: Investment Features
requirements.description: Enable the purchasing of fractional ETFs and provide portfolio rebalancing
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to buy and sell investments, so that I can grow my wealth

requirements.title: Tax Document Generation
requirements.description: System generates tax documents, including 1099-DIV
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to generate tax documents, so that I can file taxes
acceptance_criteria: Documents are available for tax season

requirements.title: Cryptocurrency Trading
requirements.description: Enable users to buy and sell cryptocurrencies
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to buy and sell cryptocurrencies, so that I can invest
acceptance_criteria: Cryptocurrencies can be bought and sold

requirements.title: Comprehensive Home Screen
requirements.description: The home screen should display total balance, provide a transaction list, and include quick action buttons, all within a well-designed and user-friendly layout.
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to view my financial information and access common actions easily from the home screen.

requirements.title: Crypto Price Tracking and Alerts
requirements.description: The app should provide real-time cryptocurrency price updates, allow for customizable thresholds, and send alert notifications when these thresholds are reached.
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to track cryptocurrency prices and receive alerts based on my custom thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Real-time crypto price updates are provided
Alerts are sent when thresholds are reached

test_steps.expected_result: Price alert is set up successfully

test_scenarios: Real-time crypto price alert with valid data

requirements.title: Investment Portfolio Management
requirements.description: The app should allow users to view their investment portfolio, including asset allocation, and provide features for managing investments.
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to manage my investment portfolio and track my investments.

requirements.title: Secure Account Opening Process
requirements.description: The app should provide a secure and comprehensive account opening process, including identity verification through Onfido.
requirements.user_story: As a new user, I want to securely open an account and verify my identity.
acceptance_criteria: Identity verification through Onfido is successful
ambiguities: What happens if the user fails identity verification?

requirements.title: Selfie Capture Interface
requirements.description: Design an interface for users to take a selfie for identity verification

requirements.title: Government-Issued ID Photo Capture Interface
requirements.description: Develop an interface for users to capture a photo of their government-issued ID for verification

requirements.title: Contact Search Functionality
requirements.description: The app allows users to search for contacts by name, phone number, or email.

requirements.title: Instant Money Transfer
requirements.description: The app enables users to send money instantly to selected contacts.

requirements.title: User Interface for Transfer
requirements.description: The app provides a user-friendly interface for users to initiate and confirm money transfers.

requirements.title: Fractional Stock Purchasing
requirements.description: The app allows users to buy fractional parts of stocks or ETFs.

requirements.title: Stock Search by Ticker
requirements.description: The app provides an option for users to search for stocks by their ticker symbols.

requirements.title: Group Management
requirements.description: The app allows users to create and manage groups for bill splitting.

requirements.title: Bill Splitting and Payment
requirements.description: The app facilitates the splitting of bills and payment among group members.

requirements.title: Account Management
requirements.description: The app allows users to view their account information, manage passwords, and ensures account security.

requirements.title: Secure Transaction Processing
requirements.description: The app ensures the security and integrity of all transactions.

requirements.title: User Account Setup
requirements.description: The app guides users through the account setup process, including registration, information validation, password creation, and account confirmation.

requirements.title: Payment Integration
requirements.description: The app integrates with payment systems to facilitate the transfer of funds according to the split bill.
